failures.message: names nothing the suite ran at head — `engine_commit(source)` in a new `saffron/engine.py` returns the text of a file named `ENGINE_COMMIT` in the directory `source`, stripped of surrounding whitespace, when that text is not empty. It does so whether or not a checkout holds `source`, and before it asks git anything. A blank file reads as no file. The witness drives a baked file inside a committed checkout and one in a directory no checkout holds. It drives two blank files inside the checkout, an empty one and one holding only a newline, a space and a newline. Each blank one reads the checkout's `HEAD`.

payload.summary: 1 of 9 criteria have no passing witness
